verdict.rationale: v0 is itself an AI agent built into the product (v0-probe-1). It plans and creates tasks as it builds (v0-docs-35), handles delegated actions such as Fix with v0, Fix Build, Fix CI and Fix Conflicts (v0-docs-20, v0-docs-26), and auto-fixes code errors (v0-docs-17). A community user confirms delegating a full internal app build end to end (v0-comm-1). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how task planning and delegation work (scope, autonomy controls, approval steps).
